c1.criterion_text: Ecological case generation is defined and required as the primary suite (not lab-only explicit $skill prompts).

c2.criterion_text: Forward-test integrity is specified (fresh threads, no gold leakage, runner not told it is testing).

c3.criterion_text: Failure labeling rules are complete, checkable, and ban invented jargon / overloaded bare nouns.

c4.criterion_text: Root-reason analysis covers layered causes and maps to caller vs callee vs harness.

c5.criterion_text: Continued improvement includes surgical edition scope limits that prevent brutal full-skill rewrites.

c6.criterion_text: Guidance is harness-agnostic enough to apply beyond a single CLI (Codex/Grok/others).

c7.criterion_text: No critical operational gap remains for a competent agent to finish a full loop (cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff).
